# Massage Langford (https://massagelangford.ca)

> Registered Massage Therapy clinic serving Langford, Colwood, and the Greater West Shore of Greater Victoria, BC.

## Business & Entity Overview
- **Business Name:** Massage Langford
- **Parent Practice / Brand Entity:** Sync Therapy (https://synctherapy.ca)
- **GBP Name:** Sync Massage Therapy
- **Category:** Medical Clinic / Registered Massage Therapy (RMT) Practice
- **Governing College:** College of Complementary Health Professionals of BC (CCHPBC)
- **Primary Practitioner:** Daryl Stubbs, RMT, CAT(C)
- **Qualifications:** Registered Massage Therapist & Certified Athletic Therapist (Dual-Credentialed)
- **Clinical Experience:** Over 10,000 hours of hands-on musculoskeletal experience
- **Address:** 132–328 Wale Rd #120, Colwood, BC V9B 1J2 (Directly adjacent to the Langford municipal border)
- **Phone:** (250) 812-8698
- **Online Booking Portal:** https://synctherapy.janeapp.com
- **Referral Policy:** No medical doctor's referral required for appointments.
- **Parking:** Dedicated, free ground-level patient parking stalls directly in front of suite #120.

## Services & Clinical Treatment Modalities
1. **Deep Tissue Massage** (https://massagelangford.ca/services/deep-tissue-massage/): Targeted neuromuscular and trigger point release for chronic back, neck, and shoulder muscle tension.
2. **Relaxation / Swedish Massage** (https://massagelangford.ca/services/relaxation-massage/): Gentle to moderate pressure therapeutic massage designed for stress reduction, nervous system down-regulation, and muscle relaxation in a quiet clinical setting.
3. **Sports Massage & Athletic Therapy** (https://massagelangford.ca/services/sports-massage-therapy/): Specialized kinetic chain assessment, tendon rehabilitation, and cross-fiber friction for local athletes and active West Shore individuals.
4. **Myofascial Release** (https://massagelangford.ca/services/myofascial-release/): Connective tissue decompression and sustained manual traction to break down fascial restrictions and restore postural alignment.

## Conditions Treated
- **Sciatica & Lower Back Pain** (https://massagelangford.ca/conditions/sciatica/): Deep gluteal and piriformis decompression to relieve sciatic nerve impingement and lumbar spasms.
- **Neck & Shoulder Tension** (https://massagelangford.ca/conditions/neck-shoulder-pain/): Cervical spine decompression, levator scapulae release, and postural relief for desk workers and computer-related tension headaches.

## Session Durations & Rates (All Taxes Included)
- **45 Minutes:** $105.00 (Taxes Included) — Targeted clinical / single focused problem area.
- **60 Minutes & Initial Assessment (Most Popular):** $130.00 (Taxes Included) — Standard comprehensive orthopedic assessment and full-body therapeutic treatment.
- **90 Minutes:** $178.50 (Taxes Included) — Extended multi-region rehabilitation, deep myofascial release, and comprehensive recovery.
- *Payment Methods:* Direct billing to extended health insurers, Visa, MasterCard, Debit.
- *Seasonal Notice:* High booking demand occurs in autumn/winter months. Patients are encouraged to book recurring appointments ahead to secure preferred times (reschedule/cancel anytime online with zero penalty).

## Location & Parking Instructions
Located inside Coastal Offices (Suite #120) at 132–328 Wale Rd, Colwood, BC V9B 1J2 (bordering Langford).
- **Free Parking:** Park free at the back of the Holiday Inn parking lot (328 Wale Rd) for flat, direct ground-level access into Coastal Offices (Suite #120).
- Driving Times: 5 minutes from Goldstream Avenue (Downtown Langford), 7 minutes from Millstream Village / Bear Mountain, and 6 minutes from Belmont Market / Westhills.
